name: queue-poc
description: On Running offline-store virtual queue — PoC (independent monorepo, NestJS + React)

scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @queue/api && npm run build -w @queue/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @queue/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @queue/api" "npm run dev -w @queue/web"
